description: GET /api/stock-records/{sku}?location= for an existing record responds with Content-Type application/json and a JSON object body
GET /api/stock-records/{sku}?location= for a missing (sku, location) responds 404 application/json with body {error: 'Stock record not found'} rather than an HTML error page
EP3 detail response for a record stored with NULL tracking_code carries JSON null for tracking_code, with no server-side 'not tracked' placeholder string
EP3 detail response carries par_level as JSON null independently of a non-null tracking_code on the same record, with the service passing each optional field through unaltered
